title: Open, separate, reopen and reverse a layered packet
instruction: The supplied paper is already prepared through O02 diagram step 2. On page 1 complete only O02 steps 3 through 5. Then continue directly on the same paper with O03 steps 4 through 9 on page 2, ending at the final state of O03 step 9. Do not reset, redo the prepared panels on page 2, or perform O02 steps 6 through 8. Page 2 prepared steps 1 through 3 show the state reached after page 1 step 5. Finish after the final illustrated partial opening. Blue is the original front, cream the original back.
source_note: Composition of existing O02 and O03 original development diagrams. This is not an independent real origami source or a held-out source. Qualification uses the two unchanged original pages with the scope stated here.
